description: Records an account recovery request. Email access alone never recovers an account; a reviewer decides each request.
name: PTR Recovery Review

fields.label: Identity Link
fields.description: Verified identity whose account recovery was requested.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Open until a reviewer approves or rejects the request. Rejected is final. After approval, the key removal step sets Removal Failed or Completed. Completed is final.
fields.options:
Open
Approved
Rejected
Removal Failed
Completed

fields.label: Requested At
fields.description: Time the recovery request was received.

fields.label: Review Note
fields.description: Required for a decision. Write how the reviewer confirmed or refused the identity.

fields.label: Reviewed By
fields.description: Reviewer who made the decision. The account owner cannot review their own request.

fields.label: Removal Attempted At
fields.description: Time of the last attempt to remove the old keys.

fields.label: Removal Error
fields.description: Short code of the last removal error: not_configured, upstream_failed or unknown. It never holds personal data.

fields.label: Completed At
fields.description: Time when the old keys were removed and the sessions ended.
